base_member_text: [L2362-L2374] (HIGH/boundary-condition typo) The MPI left-boundary clause repeats Wm(1,:)=Wm(2,:) instead of setting Wm(:,1), so the left y boundary is not populated as the surrounding top/bottom/left/right pattern indicates.
audit_member_text: [L2362-L2374] (HIGH/MPI boundary indexing) The xmpi_isleft branch assigns Wm(1,:) instead of Wm(:,1), overwriting the top x row and leaving the left y boundary unset.

base_member_text: [L254-L372] (MED/lifecycle/allocation) nonh_init allocates module work arrays unconditionally, so a second initialization or a grid-size change without an intervening teardown can fail or retain an incompatible module lifecycle.
audit_member_text: [L290-L356] (MED/reinitialization/configuration lifecycle) nonh_init allocates module arrays unconditionally and never supports cleanup, resizing, or changing nonhq3d mode during a later model lifecycle.

base_member_text: [L3453-L3465] (LOW/iteration termination) disper iterates solely on an error tolerance with no iteration cap or invalid-input guard, leaving termination dependent on unstated positive finite inputs.
audit_member_text: [L3311-L3319,L3420-L3465] (MED/unbounded/singular dispersion solve) wcoef initialization does not validate Topt, and disper has singular arithmetic for zero frequency/depth plus an iteration with no maximum-count or stagnation guard.

base_member_text: [L1694-L1720,L1917-L1922,L2546-L2599,L2974-L3027] (HIGH/unchecked singular denominator) Reduced two-layer formulas divide by wcoef, 1-wcoef, and nhlay-nhlay**2 without a local bound excluding 0 or 1, so endpoint layer coefficients make the predictor or stress terms singular.
audit_member_text: [L1694-L1720,L1912-L1925,L2546-L2599,L2968-L3031] (HIGH/singular layer-fraction formulas) Reduced-layer formulas divide by 1-wcoef, 2-wcoef sums, and nhlay-nhlay^2 while only checking nhlay>0, so nhlay/wcoef equal or near one makes the system singular.

base_member_text: [L3013-L3021] (HIGH/staggered-field mix-up) The lower-layer V-velocity friction calculation uses s%cfu rather than the V-point friction field s%cfv.
[L3031-L3041] (HIGH/staggered-index mix-up) The V-point corrector averages wcoef(i,j) with wcoef(i+1,j), using an x neighbor where the V staggering calls for the j+1 neighbor.
audit_member_text: [L3013-L3046] (HIGH/wrong directional friction data) The dV bottom-friction update uses s%cfu rather than the V-face friction coefficient and averages wcoef across i/i+1 rather than j/j+1.

base_member_text: [L752-L764] (HIGH/variable mix-up) In the one-layer excluded-point bottom-slope correction, the west bottom slope is assigned from dzs_e rather than dzb_e, mixing the surface and bottom geometries.
audit_member_text: [L758-L781] (HIGH/wrong-variable typo) In the 1-D excluded-point bottom boundary calculation, dzb_w is assigned dzs_e instead of dzb_e, mixing free-surface and bed slopes.

base_member_text: [L853-L879] (HIGH/variable mix-up/stale state) The corresponding bottom-slope branch assigns dzb_w from dzs_e and its final fallback clears the x slopes instead of dzb_s/dzb_n, leaving erroneous y-direction bottom slopes.
audit_member_text: [L853-L882] (HIGH/wrong-variable typo) In the 2-D excluded-point bottom condition, the both-wet U branch assigns dzb_w=dzs_e rather than dzb_e.

base_member_text: [L2494-L2497] (MED/coefficient inconsistency) The 3D U predictor uses wcoef(i,j) for both neighboring pressure coefficients, unlike the analogous 2DV expression which uses wcoef(i+1,j) on the eastern contribution.
audit_member_text: [L2494-L2497] (HIGH/wrong adjacent layer coefficient) The 3-D U-pressure east coefficient uses wcoef(i,j) for the i+1 cell, inconsistent with its hh(i+1,j), the 2-DV implementation, and the analogous V coefficient.

base_member_text: [L2569-L2574] (HIGH/sign inconsistency) The 3D V predictor forms its surface-slope coefficient with zs(i,j)-zs(i,j+1), the opposite orientation to both its bottom term and the analogous U-direction expression.
audit_member_text: [L2544-L2550,L2571-L2575] (MED/directional sign inconsistency) The dV pressure correction forms surface and wcoef differences as current-minus-next while dU uses next-minus-current, despite the base U/V pressure gradients sharing the same orientation.

base_member_text: [L824-L836] (HIGH/variable mix-up/stale state) The two-dimensional excluded-point surface-slope branch assigns dzs_n from dzb_s when both V points are wet and clears dzs_e/dzs_w, rather than dzs_s/dzs_n, in its fallback, so the y slopes can be wrong or stale.
audit_member_text: [L824-L841] (HIGH/wrong-variable typo) In the 2-D excluded-point surface condition, the both-wet V branch assigns dzs_n=dzb_s rather than dzs_s, injecting a bed-slope value into the surface condition.

base_member_text: [L323-L347,L995,L1009] (MED/grid-metric consistency) The legacy solver stores only dsu(:,1) and dnv(1,:) and later uses those fixed cross-sections throughout the domain, leaving the full-2D curvilinear-grid contract unclear.

[L3307-L3327] (MED/parameter-domain contract) nonh_init_wcoef accepts an unconstrained explicit dispc and computes the optimized value through a denominator that is neither checked nor bounded, despite downstream singularities at endpoint or invalid coefficients.

[L3403-L3414] (MED/one-dimensional indexing) For ny<=2 the V-point free surface is filled from one fixed zs column (column 2 when present) for every j, rather than from the matching column, and the special-case intent is unclear.

audit_member_text: [L201-L247] (LOW/unchecked selector) Any ipredcor value other than zero silently selects the correction path, so an invalid selector is accepted as a valid corrector request.

[L288-L372,L453-L455,L961-L963,L1655-L1659,L2479-L2483] (MED/initialization lifecycle) The one-layer routines lazily initialize module storage, but the reduced two-layer predictor paths do not, leaving their correctness dependent on an undocumented external nonh_init call.
[L323-L347] (MED/unchecked grid denominator) The original formulation constructs reciprocal grid spacings without checking for zero or invalid ds/dn metrics.

[L556-L558,L1138-L1157,L1176-L1187,L1254-L1258] (MED/depth denominator contract) Several one-layer pressure, advection, viscosity, and explicit-pressure terms divide by hh based on nonhZ rather than an explicit positive-depth check, relying on the mask contract to guarantee a safe depth.

[L1172-L1177] (HIGH/directional coefficient mismatch) The y-direction vertical-viscosity flux uses s%hu at lines 1174-1175 even though it is evaluated across V faces, unlike the expected y-face depth s%hv.

[L1371-L1383,L1453-L1484,L2048-L2150,L2244-L2284] (MED/stale interpolated geometry) Both reduced correctors claim to recalculate zsu/zsv/zbu/zbv but contain no zuzv call, so matrix and kinematic corrections use geometry last computed in the predictor.

[L3369-L3401] (MED/MPI halo initialization) On non-bottom MPI ranks zbu(nx+1,:) and zsu(nx+1,:) are not assigned or exchanged by zuzv, although nonh mask construction iterates through nx+1 and reads zbu there.
